items.title: Smoother notification swipe
items.description: Swipe a notification left or right and it follows your finger, fades slowly and slides away, like Android notifications. A small swipe just springs back.

items.title: Fewer stock alerts
items.description: Your holdings now alert only when they move 4% or 5% up or down in a day, instead of at 2%.

items.title: Correct prices without refreshing
items.description: A wrong live price no longer sticks until you refresh. Total returns now fix themselves on their own.

items.title: Net worth chart waits for live prices
items.description: The chart's latest value no longer shows a wrong number while prices are still loading.
